verdict.rationale: React clearly supports building encapsulated, composable components (react-gh-1, react-gh-3), giving strong modularity, but the evidence pack contains no mention of a dependency-injection mechanism (React relies on props/Context rather than a DI container, and none of the docs or community citations discuss DI patterns). missing for 10: explicit dependency-injection mechanism or pattern documentation, independent corroboration of DI usage in React apps.
